name: freakyfashion-react
description: Freaky Fashion e-commerce store with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: cd server && npm install && npm start
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
